channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Extra trains for All-Ireland club finals
item.description: Irish Rail is putting on extra trains for Sunday's All-Ireland club finals.

item.title: Munster chief: schedule was too tight for Munster hurling final replay
item.description: Munster GAA CEO Kieran Leddy has claimed the schedule was too tight for last year's Munster SHC final to go to a replay.

item.title: Geaney taking a 'big break' after All-Ireland club final
item.description: Paul Geaney is unlikely to play any part in Kerry's upcoming Allianz Football League defence after revealing that he plans on taking a break after Sunday's All-Ireland club SFC final.

item.title: Connacht GAA air dome set to reopen
item.description: The Connacht GAA air dome which was destroyed by Storm Eowyn a year ago is set to reopen in April.

item.title: Donegal and Monaghan set for McKenna Cup final showdown
item.description: Donegal will play Monaghan in Saturday Dr McKenna Cup final after both sides recorded victories in their respective semi-finals last night (Wednesday).

item.title: UCC earn home quarter-final in Sigerson Cup
item.description: Cian O'Brien struck for 1-2 early in the second-half as University of Ulster defeated MTU Cork by 1-16 to 1-11 in Round 2B of the Sigerson Cup in Belfield last night (Wednesday).

item.title: Fitzgibbon to captain Rebels for 2026
item.description: Darragh Fitzgibbon will captain Cork's senior hurlers for the 2026 season.

item.title: McGuinness planning to rotate players for McKenna Cup final
item.description: Donegal manager Jim McGuinness says he'll probably look to rotate some of his players for Saturday's Dr McKenna Cup final against Monaghan.

item.title: Rouine named new Clare captain
item.description: Cillian Rouine will captain Clare's senior footballers for the 2026 season.

item.title: Kinsella a doubt for Royals' league opener
item.description: Meath could be without key attacker Ruairi Kinsella for their Allianz Football League Division 2 opener against Derry on Saturday week.
